unclear_rules.topic: Speed band for units that only teleport
unclear_rules.note: The registry allows banding chrono units from their infobox land speed. But the speed_raw rule excludes figures whose scale the source does not explain, and Speed bands asks for a sustained travel speed, which for a teleporter is an instant jump plus a distance-scaled freeze. The result flips the Chrono Legionnaire's primary role between assault and raider. A ruling is needed.

unclear_rules.topic: Remote crew model with a building as the operator
unclear_rules.note: The remote rule needs a person on the field outside the machine, and says lore about remote control does not count. For the Robot Tank the in-game fact is dependence on a building, and the operators exist only in background text. It is unclear whether remote is allowed here.

unclear_rules.topic: Root plus silence outside the EMP family
unclear_rules.note: Only the EMP tie-break sanctions pairing root and silence for 'can do neither'. The trait definitions taken alone contradict a full freeze. It is unclear whether other families (a stasis beam) may use the pair.

unclear_rules.topic: Does a beam that erases without lowering health 'do no damage'?
unclear_rules.note: This decides whether damage step 2 and can_target step 1 (list only the kinds the sources name) apply to the chrono beam. Here it changed nothing for damage, but it could remove naval from can_target.

unclear_rules.topic: Movement that is not a button
unclear_rules.note: The abilities rule counts buttons, plus passives where the source names the effect and it adds a mechanic. It also says to use a word-list term (the teleport trait) when one says the same. It is unclear whether a teleport-on-move unit should carry both the trait and a passive linking the teleport pattern; I did both, as the task asked.

unclear_rules.note: The Robot Tank's roles step 1 rests on an official profile I could not open. The rules do not say whether a registry note's reading of official text can stand in for reading the page.

new_mechanics.summary: The unit works only while a friendly relay (a control building, a beacon or a commander unit) stands and has power. If the relay is destroyed, captured or starved of power, every unit tied to it shuts down where it is (and sinks if it is over water) until a working relay exists again. Counterplay: find and destroy or cut power to the relay, raid its power supply, or catch the units over water when it goes down; the owner protects the relay or builds a spare.

I deleted those two files, and a `mkdir -p` in the same command may also have created an empty tools folder there, which I left in place.
